paragraphs: We are a Fortune 1000 Global Solutions Provider that simplifies IT, guiding the connection between people and technology. Our dedicated account managers partner with customers to design, deploy, and support cutting-edge IT environments using the latest hardware, software, and services. We provide a wide range of IT solutions, from the desktop to the cloud—including computer systems, data center solutions, security, artificial intelligence, or AI, software and peripheral equipment, networking communications, and other products and accessories that we develop internally and secure from manufacturers, distributors, and other suppliers. Our Technology Solutions and Services Organization, or TSSO, and state-of-the-art ISO 9001:2015 SOC 2 Type 2 certified Technology Integration and Distribution Center, or TIDC, offer end-to-end services related to the design, configuration, and implementation of IT solutions. Our team also provides a comprehensive portfolio of managed services and professional services. These services are performed by our personnel and by third-party providers. Our GlobalServe offering ensures worldwide coverage for our multinational customers, delivering global procurement solutions through our network of in-country suppliers in over 150 countries.

The "Connection" brand includes Connection Enterprise Solutions, Connection Business Solutions, and Connection Public Sector Solutions. We united all of our subsidiaries into one cohesive brand, reflecting the promise of our blue arc and our mission to connect people with technology that enhances growth, elevates productivity, and empowers innovation. These entities represent our three operating segments and their respective markets:
● Connection Enterprise Solutions – serving large enterprise customers ● Connection Business Solutions – serving small- to medium-sized businesses, or SMBs
● Connection Public Sector Solutions – serving federal, state, and local government and educational institutions

Financial results for each of our segments are included in the financial statements attached hereto. We generate sales through (i) outbound inside sales and field sales contacts by sales representatives focused on the business, educational, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, and government markets, (ii) our websites, and (iii) direct responses from customers responding to our outreach. We offer a broad selection of over 460,000 products at competitive prices, including products from vendors like Apple, Cisco, Dell Inc., HP Inc., Hewlett-Packard Enterprise, Intel, Lenovo, Microsoft Corporation, and VMware by Broadcom, and we partner with more than 1,600 suppliers. We are able to leverage our state-of-the art logistic capabilities to rapidly ship product to customers.

We strive to identify the unique needs of our corporate, government, educational, and small business customers, and have designed our business processes to enable our customers to effectively manage their IT systems. We provide value by offering our customers efficient design, integration, deployment, and support of their IT environments. As of December 31, 2025, we employed 679 sales representatives. Sales representatives are responsible for managing enterprise, commercial, and public sector accounts, as specialization and a deep understanding of unique customer environments are more important than ever. These sales representatives focus on current and prospective customers and are supported by an increasing number of engineering, technical, and administrative staff through our TSSO. Our Industry Solutions Group, or ISG, provides our sales team and customers with insights and guidance customized to the unique needs of our vertical markets, including healthcare, retail, finance, and manufacturing. We believe that increasing our sales force productivity is important to our future success.

We market our products and services through our websites: www.connection.com, www.connection.com/enterprise, www.connection.com/publicsector, and www.cnxnhelix.com. Our websites provide extensive product information, customized pricing, rich content, and a digital platform for online orders. We are not including the information contained in our websites as part of, or incorporating by reference into, this Annual Report on Form 10-K.

In the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, we generated approximately 44.6% of our sales from medium-to-large businesses (Fortune 1000), 37.7% from SMBs, and 17.7% from government and educational institutions.

The largest segment of the United States IT market that we operate within is served by local and regional value-added resellers, or VARs, many of whom engage in the sales of hardware and software products, as well as higher-margin IT services. We have adapted our business over the years to become an enterprise-wide IT solutions supplier. We have also partnered with third-party technology and telecommunications service providers to offer our customers access to the same services and technical expertise as local and regional VARs, but with a more extensive product selection, often at lower prices.

Intense competition for customers has led manufacturers of the IT products we offer to use all available distribution channels, including solutions providers, to distribute their products. Certain manufacturers who have traditionally used resellers to distribute their products have also, from time to time, established their own direct marketing operations, including sales through the Internet.
We believe new entrants to the IT solutions channel must overcome a number of obstacles, including:
● substantial time and resources required to build a customer base of meaningful size and profitability for cost-effective operation;
● significant upfront costs of developing the information systems and operating infrastructure required to successfully compete as a national solutions provider;
● purchasing and operating efficiencies enjoyed by larger and more established competitors;

headings: Risks Related to our Business, Operations and Industry
We have experienced variability in sales and may not be able to maintain profitable operations.
Substantial competition could reduce our market share and may negatively affect our business.
We face and will continue to face significant price competition, which could result in a reduction of our profit margins.
Inflation may adversely impact our business, financial condition and results of operations.
The interruption of the flow of products from suppliers could disrupt our supply chain.
Failure to provide high quality services to our clients could adversely affect our reputation, brand, business, results of operations or cash flows.
General economic and political conditions, including unfavorable conditions in a business or industry sector, may lead our clients to delay or forgo investments in IT hardware, software and services.
We acquire a majority of our products for resale from a limited number of vendors. The loss of any one of these vendors could have a material adverse effect on our business.
Virtualization of IT resources and applications, including networks, servers, applications, and data storage may disrupt or alter our traditional distribution models.
The methods of distributing IT products are changing, and such changes may negatively impact us and our business.
We depend heavily on third-party shippers to deliver our products to customers and would be adversely affected by a service interruption by these shippers.
We may experience increases in shipping and postage costs, which may adversely affect our business if we are not able to pass such increases on to our customers.
We may experience a reduction in the incentive programs offered to us by our vendors.
Should our financial performance not meet expectations, we may be required to record a significant charge to earnings for impairment of goodwill and other intangibles.
We are exposed to inventory obsolescence due to the rapid technological changes occurring in the IT industry.
We are exposed to accounts receivable risk and if customers fail to timely pay amounts due to us, our results of operations and/or cash flows could be adversely affected.
Risks Related to Our Technology, Data and Intellectual Property
Cyberattacks or the failure to safeguard personal information and our IT systems could result in liability and harm our reputation, which could adversely affect our business.
Our business could be materially adversely affected by system failures, interruption, integration issues, or security lapses of our IT systems or those of our third-party providers.
We are reliant on the continued development of electronic commerce and Internet infrastructure development to grow our overall sales.
We could experience Internet and other system failures which would interfere with our ability to process orders.
Privacy concerns with respect to list development and maintenance may materially adversely affect our business.
Risks Related to Regulatory and Legal Matters
We are exposed to risks from legal proceedings and audits, which may result in substantial costs and expenses or interruption of our normal business operations.
The failure to comply with our public sector contracts could result in, among other things, fines or liabilities.
We face uncertainties relating to the collection of state sales and use tax.
Risks Related to Our Common Stock
We are controlled by one principal stockholder.

● shifts in customer demand that affect our distribution models, including demand for total solutions;
● loss of customers to competitors; ● rising interest rates; ● inflation; ● industry shipments of new products or upgrades;
● changes in overall demand and timing of product shipments related to economic markets and to government spending;
● supply constraints; ● changes in vendor distribution of products; ● changes in referral fee structures offered to us by partners;

paragraphs: The following Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations, or MD&A, is intended to promote an understanding of our results of operations and financial condition. MD&A is provided as a supplement to, and should be read in conjunction with, our consolidated financial statements and the accompanying notes thereto included in Part II, Item 8 of this Annual Report on Form 10-K. This section discusses the results of operations for the year ended December 31, 2025 and year-to-year comparison between the year ended December 31, 2025 and the year ended December 31, 2024. Discussion of the year ended December 31, 2024 and the year-to-year comparison between the year ended December 31, 2024 and the year ended December 31, 2023 can be found in Part II, Item 7 "Management's Discussions and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" of our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2024. Our MD&A also includes discussion of certain forward-looking trends and other statements that predict or anticipate future business or financial results that are subject to important factors that could cause our actual results to differ materially from those indicated. See "Cautionary Note Concerning Forward-Looking Statements" and "Item 1A. Risk Factors" of this Annual Report on Form 10-K.

We are a Fortune 1000 Global Solutions Provider that simplifies IT, guiding the connection between people and technology. Our dedicated account managers partner with customers to design, deploy, and support cutting-edge IT environments using the latest hardware, software, and services. We provide a wide range of IT solutions, from the desktop to the cloud—including computer systems, data center solutions, security, AI, software and peripheral equipment, networking communications, and other products and accessories that we develop internally and secure from manufacturers, distributors, and other suppliers. Our TSSO and state-of-the-art ISO 9001:2015 SOC 2 Type 2 certified TIDC offer end-to-end services related to the design, configuration, and implementation of IT solutions. Our team also provides a comprehensive portfolio of managed services and professional services. These services are performed by our personnel and by third-party providers. Our GlobalServe offering ensures worldwide coverage for our multinational customers, delivering global procurement solutions through our network of in-country suppliers in over 150 countries.

The "Connection" brand includes Connection Enterprise Solutions, Connection Business Solutions, and Connection Public Sector Solutions, which provide IT solutions and services to enterprise, SMBs, and public sector markets.

Financial results for each of our segments are included in the financial statements attached hereto. We generate sales through (i) outbound inside sales and field sales contacts by sales representatives focused on the business, educational, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, and government markets, (ii) our websites, and (iii) direct responses from customers responding to our advertising media. We offer a broad selection of over 460,000 products at competitive prices, including products from vendors like Apple, Cisco, Dell Inc., HP Inc., Hewlett-Packard Enterprise, Intel, Lenovo, Microsoft Corporation, and VMware by Broadcom, and we partner with more than 1,600 suppliers. We are able to leverage our state-of-the art logistic capabilities to rapidly ship product to customers.

As a value-added reseller in the IT supply chain, we do not manufacture IT hardware or software products. We are dependent on our suppliers—manufacturers and distributors that historically have only sold to resellers rather than directly to end users. However, certain manufacturers have, on multiple occasions, sold or attempted to sell directly to our customers, and in some cases, have restricted our ability to sell their products directly to certain customers, thereby attempting to and, in some cases successfully, eliminate our role. We believe that the success of these direct sales efforts by manufacturers will depend on their ability to meet our customers' ongoing demands and provide solutions to meet their needs. We believe more of our customers are seeking out comprehensive and integrated IT solutions, rather than the ability to acquire specific IT products on a one-off basis. Our advantage is our ability to be product-neutral and provide a broader combination of products, services, and advice tailored to our customers' individual needs. By providing customers with customized solutions from a variety of manufacturers, we believe we can mitigate the negative impact of continued direct sales initiatives from individual manufacturers. Through the formation of our TSSO, we are able to provide customers complete IT solutions, from identifying their needs, to designing, developing, and managing the integration of products and services to implement their IT projects. Such service offerings carry higher margins than traditional product sales. Additionally, the technical certifications of our service engineers permit us to offer higher-end, more complex products that generally carry higher gross margins. We expect these service offerings and technical
certifications to continue to play a role in sales generation and gross margin improvements in this competitive environment.

The primary challenges we continue to face in effectively managing our business are (1) increasing our product and service revenues while at the same time improving our gross margin in all three segments, (2) recruiting, retaining, and improving the productivity of our sales and technical support personnel, and (3) effectively controlling our SG&A expenses while making major investments in our IT systems and solution selling personnel, especially in relation to changing revenue levels.

To support future growth, we have invested and expect to continue to invest in our IT solutions business, which requires the addition of highly skilled service engineers. Although we expect to realize the ultimate benefit of higher-margin service revenues under this multi-year initiative, we believe that our cost of services will increase as we add additional service engineers. If our service revenues do not grow enough to offset the cost of these headcount additions, our operating results may be negatively impacted.

Market conditions and technology advances significantly affect the demand for our products and services. Virtual delivery of software products and advanced Internet technology providing customers enhanced functionality have substantially increased customer expectations, requiring us to invest on an ongoing basis in our own IT infrastructure to meet these new demands.
Our investments in IT infrastructure are designed to enable us to operate more efficiently and provide our customers enhanced functionality.

● As the AI market continues to evolve, it is difficult to predict and forecast its potential impact on our business and results of operations in the future. We may be required to make significant investments to keep up with increasing competition surrounding AI. Additionally, potential issues with the AI products we sell could have an adverse effect on our business and results of operations in the future.

● Inflation due to, among other things, higher interest rates and the uncertain economic environment, impacts product costs and wages. The increased product costs and wages due to inflation may adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations. If product costs and wages increase significantly or for an extended period of time, we may not be able to adjust prices to sufficiently offset the effect of the various cost increases without negatively impacting customer demand.

● The Federal Reserve decreased interest rates in 2025, but it is uncertain whether interest rates will remain the same, decrease, or increase in 2026. Should we need to borrow in the future, we may be exposed to high interest rates. Additionally, if interest rates were to decrease, our interest income on our cash equivalents and short-term investments would also decrease.
● The impact of tariffs remains uncertain. If the economic impact of any imposed tariff is passed through to us by our vendors, our results of operations could be impacted.

{'● Connection Enterprise Solutions – serving large enterprise customers ● Connection Business Solutions – serving small- to medium-sized businesses, or SMBs': '● Connection Enterprise Solutions – 服務大型企業客戶 ● Connection Business Solutions – 服務中小型企業，或SMBs'}
{'● Connection Public Sector Solutions – serving federal, state, and local government and educational institutions': '● Connection Public Sector Solutions – 服務聯邦、州及地方政府與教育機構'}

各應報告分部之財務結果已包含於本處所附之財務報表中。我們透過 (i) 銷售代表專注於企業、教育、醫療、零售、製造及政府市場之出庫內勤銷售及現場銷售聯繫，(ii) 我們之網站，以及 (iii) 客戶對我們之拓展活動做出反應之直接回應，來產生銷售額。我們提供超過 460,000 種產品之廣泛選擇，價格具有競爭力，包括來自 Apple、Cisco、Dell Inc.、HP Inc.、Hewlett-Packard Enterprise、Intel、Lenovo、Microsoft Corporation 及 VMware by Broadcom 等供應商之產品，我們與超過 1,600 家供應商合作。我們能運用我們最先進之物流能力，迅速將產品運送到客戶手中。

我們致力於識別我們企業、政府、教育及中小企業客戶之獨特需求，並設計我們之業務流程，使客戶能有效管理其資訊科技系統。我們透過提供客戶其資訊科技環境之高效設計、整合、部署及支援，來創造價值。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們僱用 679 名銷售代表。銷售代表負責管理企業、商業及公共部門帳戶，因為專業化及對獨特客戶環境之深入理解比以往更加重要。這些銷售代表專注於現有及潛在客戶，並透過我們之 TSSO 獲得越來越多工程、技術及行政人員之支援。我們之產業解決方案組，或稱 ISG，為我們之銷售團隊及客戶提供根據我們垂直市場之獨特需求而量身打造之見解與指導，包括醫療、零售、金融及製造業。我們認為提高銷售團隊之生產力對我們未來之成功至關重要。

我們透過以下網站來行銷我們之產品與服務：www.connection.com、www.connection.com/enterprise、www.connection.com/publicsector 及 www.cnxnhelix.com。我們之網站提供廣泛之產品資訊、客製化價格、豐富內容及線上訂購之數位平台。我們不將網站所包含之資訊納入本年度報告 10-K 之中，亦不將其透過參考方式納入本年度報告 10-K。
在截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日之會計年度，我們約有 44.6% 之銷售來自中大型企業（財富 1000 大企業），37.7% 來自中小企業，17.7% 來自政府及教育機構。
我們所經營的美國資訊科技市場中，規模最大的分部是由本地及區域性增值經銷商，或稱 VARs 服務，許多 VARs 會從事硬體與軟體產品的銷售，以及較高毛利的資訊科技服務。我們在多年來已調整業務模式，成為一個企業級的資訊科技解決方案供應商。我們也與第三方科技與電信服務供應商合作，為客戶提供與本地及區域性 VARs 相同的服務與技術專業知識，但通常具有更廣的產品選擇，且價格較低。
對客戶的激烈競爭促使我們所提供的資訊科技產品製造商使用所有可用的通路，包括解決方案供應商，來銷售其產品。某些傳統上使用經銷商來銷售產品的製造商，也偶爾設立自己的直接行銷業務，包括透過網路進行銷售。
我們認為新進的資訊科技解決方案通路必須克服許多障礙，包括：
● 建立具規模且具盈利能力的客戶羣所需花費的大量時間與資源；
● 開發資訊系統與運作基礎設施所需的高額前期成本，以成功競爭為全國性的解決方案供應商；
● 較大且更具規模的競爭對手所享有的採購與運作效率；

paragraphs: 以下為管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之分析（以下簡稱「MD&A」），旨在說明本公司營運成果與財務狀況。MD&A 作為補充資料，應與本公司合併財務報表及其附註說明一併閱讀，內容載於本年度10-K申報表第二部分，第8項。本節討論的是截至2025年12月31日止之年度營運成果，以及2025年12月31日止年度與2024年12月31日止年度之年對年比較。2024年12月31日止年度之營運成果及2024年12月31日止年度與2023年12月31日止年度之年對年比較，請參閱本公司2024年12月31日止年度10-K申報表第二部分，第7項「管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之分析」。本公司MD&A亦包含對某些展望性趨勢及其他預測或預期未來營運或財務結果之說明，這些結果可能受重要因素影響，使本公司實際結果與所預期者有重大差異。請參閱本年度10-K申報表之「展望性陳述警示」及「第1A項 風險因素」。

本公司為全球解決方案供應商，為Fortune 1000企業，簡化資訊科技，引導人與科技之間的連結。我們專注的客戶經理與客戶合作，設計、部署及支援最先進的資訊科技環境，運用最新硬體、軟體及服務。我們提供廣泛的資訊科技解決方案，從桌面到雲端，包括電腦系統、資料中心解決方案、安全、人工智慧、軟體及周邊設備、網路通訊，以及其他我們自行開發並從製造商、經銷商及其他供應商取得的產品與配件。我們的TSSO及具ISO 9001:2015 SOC 2 Type 2認證的TIDC，提供與資訊科技解決方案設計、設定及實作相關的端到端服務。我們的團隊亦提供完整的管理服務與專業服務。這些服務由本公司員工及第三方供應商執行。我們的GlobalServe方案確保為多國客戶提供全球覆蓋，透過我們在超過150個國家的在地供應商網路，提供全球採購解決方案。
「Connection」品牌包含Connection Enterprise Solutions、Connection Business Solutions及Connection Public Sector Solutions，為企業、中小企業與公部門市場提供資訊科技解決方案與服務。

本公司各應報告分部之財務結果已包含於本附屬文件之財務報表中。我們透過(i)銷售代表專注於企業、教育、醫療、零售、製造及政府市場之出貨內勤銷售及現場銷售接觸，(ii)我們的網站，以及(iii)客戶對我們廣告媒體之直接回應來產生銷售。我們提供超過460,000種產品，價格具有競爭力，包括來自Apple、Cisco、Dell Inc.、HP Inc.、Hewlett-Packard Enterprise、Intel、Lenovo、Microsoft Corporation及VMware by Broadcom等供應商的產品，並與超過1,600家供應商合作。我們能運用先進的物流能力，迅速將產品運送到客戶手中。

作為資訊科技供應鏈中的增值經銷商，我們並不製造資訊科技硬體或軟體產品。我們依賴於供應商—製造商與經銷商，這些供應商歷來僅銷售給經銷商，而非直接銷售給終端用戶。然而，某些製造商曾多次直接銷售或試圖直接銷售給我們的客戶，並在某些情況下限制我們直接銷售其產品給特定客戶，從而試圖消除我們的角色，有時甚至成功做到。我們認為製造商直接銷售努力的成功將取決於其能否持續滿足我們客戶的需求，並提供解決方案以符合其需求。我們認為越來越多的客戶尋求的是全面且整合的資訊科技解決方案，而非僅僅是單次取得特定資訊科技產品的能力。我們的優勢在於我們能保持產品中立，並提供更廣泛的產品、服務與建議，以符合客戶個別需求。透過提供來自多個製造商的客製化解決方案，我們認為我們可以緩解製造商持續直接銷售計劃對我們造成的負面影響。透過成立我們的 TSSO，我們能為客戶提供完整的資訊科技解決方案，從識別其需求，到設計、開發及管理產品與服務的整合，以執行其資訊科技專案。這些服務業務的毛利率高於傳統的產品銷售。此外，我們服務工程師的技術認證使我們能夠提供更高階、更複雜的產品，這些產品通常具有更高的毛利率。我們預期這些服務業務與技術認證在這個競爭環境中，會繼續在銷售產生與毛利率提升方面發揮作用。
技術認證在銷售產生與毛利率提升方面會繼續發揮作用。
我們持續面臨有效管理業務的主要挑戰為 (1) 增加產品與服務收入，同時在三個應報告分部內提高毛利率， (2) 招募、留住並提升銷售與技術支援人員的生產力，以及 (3) 有效控制我們的營運及行政費用，同時在資訊科技系統與解決方案銷售人員上進行重大投資，特別是在收入水準變動的關係上。
為支持未來成長，我們已投資並預期會持續投資於資訊科技解決方案業務，這需要增加高技能的服務工程師。雖然我們預期在這個多年計劃下能實現更高毛利率服務收入的最終效益，但我們認為隨著增加更多服務工程師，我們的服務成本將會提高。如果我們的服務收入無法足夠抵銷這些人數增加的成本，我們的營運結果可能會受到負面影響。
市場狀況與科技進步顯著影響我們產品與服務的需求。軟體產品的虛擬交付與提供客戶增強功能的先進互聯網科技，已大幅提高客戶期望，使我們必須持續投資於自身的資訊科技基礎建設，以符合這些新需求。
我們對資訊科技基礎建設的投資，旨在使我們能更有效運作，並為客戶提供增強功能。
● 隨著人工智慧市場持續演進，預測與預估其對我們業務與未來營運成果的潛在影響，具有困難。我們可能需要進行重大投資，以跟上圍繞人工智慧的競爭。此外，我們所銷售的人工智慧產品潛在問題，可能對我們的業務與未來營運成果產生負面影響。
● 因諸如較高利率與不確定經濟環境等因素導致的通貨膨脹，影響產品成本與工資。因通貨膨脹導致的產品成本與工資增加，可能對我們的業務、財務狀況與營運成果產生負面影響。若產品成本與工資大幅增加或持續一段時間，我們可能無法調整價格以足夠抵銷各種成本增加的影響，而不會對客戶需求造成負面影響。
● 美國聯邦儲備銀行於2025年降低利率，但2026年利率是否維持不變、降低或提高仍不確定。若我們未來需要借款，可能面臨高利率的風險。此外，若利率下降，我們現金等價物與短期投資的利息收入也會下降。
● 貿易稅的影響仍不確定。若我們的供應商將任何所課徵貿易稅的經濟影響轉嫁給我們，可能影響我們的營運成果。

headings: 與本公司業務、營運及產業相關之風險
我們已經驗過銷售額之波動，且可能無法維持獲利營運。
龐大競爭可能降低我們的市佔率，並可能對本公司業務產生負面影響。
我們面臨且將持續面臨顯著的價格競爭，這可能會導致我們的毛利邊際減少。
通貨膨脹可能對本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果產生不利影響。
供應商產品流動中斷可能幹擾我們的供應鏈。
未能為客戶提供高品質服務，可能對本公司聲譽、品牌、業務、營運成果或現金流產生不利影響。
總體經濟與政治條件，包括特定產業或商業部門之不利條件，可能導致客戶延後或放棄對資訊科技硬體、軟體及服務之投資。
我們約百分之八十的產品為轉售，來自有限數量的供應商。失去其中任何一家供應商，可能對我們的業務造成重大不利影響。
資訊科技資源與應用的虛擬化，包括網路、伺服器、應用程式及資料儲存，可能幹擾或改變我們傳統的分銷模式。
資訊科技產品的分銷方式正在改變，這些改變可能對我們及我們的業務產生負面影響。
我們嚴重依賴第三方運輸業者將產品運送到客戶手中，若這些運輸業者服務中斷，將對我們造成不利影響。
我們可能面臨運輸與郵資成本的增加，若無法將這些成本轉嫁給客戶，可能對我們的業務造成不利影響。
我們可能面臨來自供應商所提供的激勵方案減少。
若我們的財務表現未達預期，我們可能需要針對商譽及其他無形資產的減損，記錄重大費用至營業收入。
由於資訊科技產業快速的技術變革，我們面臨存貨過時的風險。
我們面臨應收帳款風險，若客戶未能及時支付應付本公司之金額，將可能對我們的營運成果及/或現金流產生不利影響。
與我們的技術、資料及智慧財產權相關之風險
網路攻擊或未能妥善保護個人資訊及資訊科技系統，可能導致我們產生責任並損害聲譽，進而對我們的業務產生不利影響。
我們的業務可能因資訊科技系統或第三方供應商之系統發生故障、中斷、整合問題或安全漏洞而受到重大不利影響。
我們依賴電子商務及網際網路基礎建設之持續發展，以促進我們整體銷售額之成長。
我們可能遭遇網際網路及其他系統故障，此將影響我們處理訂單之能力。
關於名單開發及維護之隱私權問題，可能對我們的業務造成重大不利影響。
與法規及法律事務相關之風險
我們面臨法律程序及審計所帶來的風險，可能會導致重大成本與費用或幹擾我們正常的業務運作。
未能遵守我們的公部門契約，可能會導致包括罰款或責任在內的後果。
我們面臨有關州級銷售及使用稅款回收的不確定性。
與我們普通股相關的風險
本公司由一位主要股東控制
paragraphs: 您應謹慎考慮下列所描述的風險與不確定性，並與本年度10-K形式年度報告及我們其他向證券交易委員會（SEC）公開檔案中所包含的所有資訊一併考量。下列所描述的風險並非我們公司所面臨的唯一風險。上述任何風險或目前未知、或我們目前認為不重要的其他風險與不確定性發生，可能會導致我們的業務、前景、營運結果與財務狀況遭受重大影響。下列風險也包含前瞻性陳述，重要因素可能會導致我們實際結果與這些前瞻性陳述所暗示或顯示的結果有重大差異。請參閱本年度10-K形式年度報告中的「前瞻性陳述警示說明」。
若干因素導致我們的營運結果出現波動，我們預期部分波動會持續存在。這些波動的原因包括：
● 客戶需求的變化影響我們的分銷模式，包括對總體解決方案的需求；
● 客戶流失至競爭對手；● 利率上升；● 通貨膨脹；● 行業新產品或升級版的出貨；
● 整體需求的變化以及產品出貨時間與經濟市場及政府支出相關；
● 供應鏈限制；● 供應商產品分銷方式的變化；● 我們的夥伴所提供的推薦費用結構的變化；
